exhibits.title: Currency of the Thirteen Colonies
exhibits.summary: A growing attempt to assemble one representative piece of paper money from each of the thirteen colonies that declared independence in 1776.

exhibits.title: Money Before the Mint
exhibits.summary: Fifteen objects trace how people in Colonial English America counted, exchanged, borrowed, and tested value before a federal coinage became ordinary.

exhibits.title: Colonial Coins and Coins from the Age of Exploration
exhibits.summary: Twelve coins spanning the Age of Exploration and the monetary world of colonial North America.

exhibits.title: Colonial Currency
exhibits.summary: Seven notes and financial documents from the Colonial Currency collection.

exhibits.title: Large Cents and Half Cents
exhibits.summary: Nine United States large cents and half cents dating from 1796 through 1856.

exhibits.title: Maps
exhibits.summary: A public catalog of historic maps and cartographic material.
